_source.generated_by: Uplift-Foundation/Orbweaver tools/relay-vectors (V6Vectors.cs: PushPersona, PromptFrames.FitPush, RelayLink.DoneE, RelayUsage.LimitE, RelayLink.PushPlaintext, PushSeal)
_source.encoding: hex is lowercase; e is base64url without padding of header(66) || nonce(12) || ciphertext || tag(16); the done and limit plaintexts are canonical (frames-v4 canonical); the amber plaintext is v3's library form as push-vectors.json pins it (\n short forms, BMP non-ASCII literal, non-BMP as uppercase \u surrogate pairs); persona is the last key of each

_rules: CB-311's orbweaver-push-v1 seal, unchanged. Each plaintext is the v3/v4 one with `persona` {id, name, image_hash?} appended as the last key (frames-v6 push_changes.persona). name is the roster name cut to 64 UTF-16 units (… last when cut). Amber fitting: detail cut at 512, persona present from the start; cut detail, then labels over 120, then DROP persona and repeat, then no e. The no_persona plaintexts equal the v3/v4 vectors' byte for byte (back-compat).
